purpose: Independent AI news for official Linkoteq social channels and the News & Updates website feed, separate from the blog workflow

work: Fetch this exact contract from dehghoon/Main-website main before researching or writing
Research timely AI news across AEC; check duplicate slugs and existing publications
Create evidence-backed platform-specific English copy and an original 5-slide creative_brief in ai_news_social_assets
Prepare draft content and assets privately. Do not publish a website card, create a publication queue, or initiate a social write during the scheduled draft run
When the owner explicitly approves publication of a specific story, use website_syndication for the website and the existing owner-directed Windsor workflow for authorized social channels
Draft five scene descriptions specific to the reported event using creative_brief_policy. Image production remains manual and keeps the existing editorial quality standards
Read back authorized writes. Report website and each social platform independently and never infer publication from pending records
Disabled: no automatic image generation, storage upload or automatic publishing
No scheduled automatic publishing; owner-directed publishing uses Windsor.ai directly after explicit instruction and public media URLs
Reconcile platform IDs and avoid duplicate posts; Supabase status is not a prerequisite for owner-directed publishing

workflow.media_generator: Disabled; owner creates five 1200x1200 slides and 1600x1200 collage in ChatGPT
workflow.publisher: Manual owner-directed Windsor.ai publication; Supabase optional for tracking
workflow.retry: Only eligible pending assets; failures explicit; never reset published posts

acceptance: Read contract on every GPT-8 run and GitHub run
Five genuinely different topical visual scenes, not just five differently colored templates
All 5 public square JPEGs and collage verified
When the owner approves social publication, keep results independent per requested platform and verify the correct media and each external post ID
No publishing until existing publisher quality checks pass
Platform IDs verified before reporting published
The website lists only approved and published cards, with one card per asset
Verified platform permalinks are added to the same website card without resending social posts

image_engine.method: local authored SVG to real JPEG via @napi-rs/canvas
image_engine.selection: Full content evidence and explicit supported scene; generic AI/software keywords alone are insufficient
image_engine.unsupported_subject: Fail explicitly; request an authored scene extension, never substitute unrelated artwork
image_engine.visual_review: Inspect relevance, composition, mobile text, cropping and distinct art; build success and different hashes alone are not visual approval

creative_brief_policy.new_story_scene: Set creative_brief.scene to the supported subject matching the actual news; never choose a supported topic merely to make rendering pass
creative_brief_policy.visual: Describe actual engineering objects, people, operation and setting from source evidence; keep one coherent story with distinct shots
creative_brief_policy.text: Short English copy within renderer-measured bounds; never crop or silently truncate
creative_brief_policy.compatibility: Existing pending briefs without scene/shot retain content-based selection and default five shots; never rewrite historical briefs

change_policy: Update this contract, validators and GPT-8 automation prompt together; retain major 1 compatibility and existing publication gates.

shared_marketing_policy.requirement: Read from main before each run; apply relevant public SEO, social metadata, CTA and conversion rules; report missing implementation without claiming success; preserve independent workflow and publication approval gates

manual_creative_workflow.notification_content: News summary, primary source, five slide briefs, platform captions and pending status

website_syndication.write_access: Authorized Supabase connection only. Public Data API can read public fields of already-published cards.
website_syndication.first_publication: After explicit owner publication instruction for this story, read the matching private asset, verify the English title and summary, original HTTPS source and approved topic-specific cover JPEG. Check actual JPEG bytes and public HTTPS reachability. Use one publicly reachable image on Linkoteq /marketing/ or the public blog-media bucket. Insert one card keyed by the existing asset_id and preserve its slug and original website publication time on future updates. An empty social_links object is valid if no platform publication is verified yet. An insert retry must use ON CONFLICT (asset_id) DO NOTHING and read back the existing card.
website_syndication.social_links: Add links only for platforms whose exact post ID and public permalink were confirmed through the platform or a trusted connector. Update only those platform keys on the same card, preserving previously verified links. Retain the existing social deduplication rules and never repost just to populate a card. Merge verified keys atomically with social_links = social_links || <verified platform object> in one update.
website_syndication.readback: Read back the saved card and verify the live website link at /news#<slug>. Report website and each social channel independently. If write or live verification fails, state the blocker and whether a write already happened so retry can safely reconcile.
website_syndication.scope: Future approved AI-news stories only. No automatic backfill, no scheduled public writes, no changes to blog publishing, media generation or account permissions.
